getting_started.label: Getting started
getting_started.title: Up and running in 5 steps
getting_started.intro: Follow this order when first setting up WinProx for your organisation.

step_1_text: Create operational teams, add workers and assign a team lead. Link teams to categories so tasks always reach the right team. Workers sign in with their name and a chosen icon. Teams and workers can also be uploaded via bulk import (CSV file).
step_2_text: Add categories to group units (e.g. drills, sanitary, fitness equipment, office, electricity). Categories help filter and organise units and depend on the sector the company operates in. By linking worker teams to specific categories, WinProx ensures tasks are handled by the correct team. Add locations (sites, buildings, floors) and create units per location — these are the assets, machines or spaces on which issues and tasks are registered. Locations and units can also be uploaded via bulk import (CSV file).
step_3_text: Print QR codes from the location or unit detail page and attach them visibly to the units (machines, printer, office, rooms, …). Reporters scan the unit QR to open the portal: they can submit an issue, consult documents and view announcements. Workers scan the team QR to link/activate dynamic QR codes, register GPS coordinates of the unit and take photos. Workers can also start and complete tasks with optional photos.
step_4_text: Issues come in via QR scan or manually. A task is automatically created for each issue, linked to the team of the unit. Multiple tasks can be created for the same issue (e.g. for the technical and cleaning team). Set a deadline and track progress via the dashboard and calendar.
step_5_text: Workers complete tasks on the floor or at the unit location via the team QR. Once all tasks are handled, the administrator closes the issue. Everything is visible in the audit trail.
